scope: Declared editor context action minimum: existing SetValue through one statically bound typed route, explicit selected owned declaration and field/JSON inputs, proposal string and function failure. No automatic Apply/Save/Confirm, arbitrary project/Blueprint execution, battle/balance semantics, generic OS/network/file bridge or persistent grants.
countingRule: Only the two final groups on the exact sourceCommit count. Earlier failures and pre-layout passes are not current results. No complete-v480/full-suite or unexecuted OS/device claim.

supersededFailedExecutions.reason: Initial new pack body local-function syntax error; corrected before actual UI
Fixture schema window intercepted the browser context click; closed through its existing control
New endpoint was missing from the bundle allowlist; added the one bounded endpoint
Same allowlist failure exposed by the bounded discovery error UI; no boundary relaxed
Fixture incorrectly expected comments in the existing SetValue formatter output; now verifies preserved metadata plus unchanged original draft/comments
Fixture reused its source Locator name as a filesystem Path; renamed the path

resources.checkout: sourceCommit ordinary Git retained CRLF after attributes pull and fresh LF; actual host, all served bytes, corruption/encoding/BOM/binary/budget refusal

platforms.linuxCommonWebUI: Actual Chromium on the ordinary EditorHome; selected existing function called through its typed port
platforms.windows: Managed composition compile only; actual Windows OS/menu unexecuted
platforms.android: Managed profile composition only; new menu dispatch unavailable; actual device unexecuted
platforms.browserWasmTarget: New menu invocation unexecuted/unavailable; common Chromium UI is a separate result

noPermissionExpansion: No arbitrary function-ID dispatch, reflection or project implementation loading
Only the known SetValue and Call source closure can be available; discovery is nonexecuting
Selection/project commands and session close retire menu tokens; no durable execution authority
No source, shared draft, original pending input or CAS replacement by returned proposals
remaining: Additional explicitly bound function/input/provider routes and their effect/ownership/result contracts
Native menu integration and actual unexecuted OS/devices
General project/Blueprint executor and new permission policy remain outside scope; domain example menus are not mandatory features
